mobile.shell.nav_label.note: Accessible name of the bottom tab bar - the mobile shell's four-section navigation (§5.2, §7.4, MOB-002/004/005).

mobile.common.error.note: Generic fallback when a list could not be loaded at all - a network failure, not a per-field refusal.

mobile.approve.title.note: MOB-004's Approve tab: draft expenses captured but not yet reviewed/completed.

mobile.approve.untitled.note: Placeholder for a barely-started capture with no supplier filled in yet.

mobile.view.document_heading.note: MOB-004's 'the document viewable at full resolution'. Identical: 'document' is the same word in Dutch and English.

mobile.invoice.title.note: MOB-005: create and send a sales invoice from the phone.

mobile.invoice.customer_vat_number.note: Identical BTW term kept in English per FR-LOC-001c - see glossary.json.

mobile.invoice.line_vat_treatment.note: Identical because BTW is a statutory term that keeps its Dutch form in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c). See glossary.json.

mobile.invoice.custom_message.note: SI-01. Label for the optional free-text note added to the covering e-mail on send - shared between SendInvoiceForm and InvoiceDetailScreen, which is why it lives in the mobile.invoice namespace both already use for shared invoicing labels.

mobile.invoice.other_problems.note: Fallback heading for a statutory failure this form has no specific control for - mirrors TemplateDesigner's 'other problems' section.

mobile.invoice.customer_problem_heading.note: Where a create-step refusal (missing/conflicting customer details) is shown - at the customer section, not a generic top-of-form banner.

mobile.shell.tab.home.note: FR-UX-005/MOB-006: the fifth tab and new default landing screen - a prioritised summary, not a sixth task.

mobile.home.cash_position_caption.note: MOB-006's honesty requirement: this is the GL balance of cash/bank accounts (RGS 'Liquide middelen'), built from what has been POSTED - not a live bank feed (FR-BNK is not built). Said explicitly so nobody reads it as real-time bank data.
mobile.home.cash_position_caption.nl: Gebaseerd op wat in de boekhouding is geboekt - geen live banksaldo.
mobile.home.cash_position_caption.en: Based on what has been posted to the books - not a live bank balance.

mobile.home.receivables_caption.en: Outstanding customer balance, regardless of due date.

mobile.home.vat_estimate_label.note: Identical BTW term kept in English per FR-LOC-001c - see glossary.json's 'btw' entry ('not VAT').

mobile.home.vat_estimate_caption.note: MOB-006's honesty requirement: FR-VAT-001's full return engine (rubrieken mapping, pre-filing validation) is not built. This is output VAT on issued invoices minus input VAT on posted expenses - a rough estimate, not a filing-ready figure, and it excludes anything not yet posted.
mobile.home.vat_estimate_caption.nl: Ruwe schatting op basis van geboekte facturen en uitgaven - geen aangifteklaar cijfer.
mobile.home.vat_estimate_caption.en: A rough estimate from posted invoices and expenses - not a filing-ready figure.

mobile.home.vat_estimate_period.note: The date range the VAT estimate covers, e.g. '1 Jan – today'. {start} and {end} are already formatted dates.

mobile.home.figures_heading.note: Heading over the three summary figures, which sit BELOW the attention list (ADR-055): they are lagging indicators nobody can act on, so they no longer open the screen.

mobile.home.items_empty_title.note: FR-UX-004: the empty state's headline. Said positively - this is the good outcome, not a missing list.

mobile.home.item_count.note: Count beside the attention heading, so the size of the job is visible before the list is read. {count} drives the plural. Dutch uses 'punt/punten' rather than the loanword 'item' - it is what a Dutch bookkeeper calls an entry on a list of things to deal with.

mobile.home.items_empty.note: FR-UX-004: an empty state teaches rather than just showing nothing. Said positively - nothing is overdue or incomplete right now.
mobile.home.items_empty.nl: Niets vraagt op dit moment uw aandacht. Openstaande facturen en onvolledige declaraties verschijnen hier.
mobile.home.items_empty.en: Nothing needs your attention right now. Overdue invoices and incomplete expenses will show up here.

mobile.home.item.overdue_invoice.note: FR-UX-005's D5-specific description for the most urgent item kind. {reference} and {customer} are the invoice's own fields; {count} is days overdue and drives the nl/en plural.

mobile.home.item.draft_expense_untitled.note: Same as mobile.home.item.draft_expense, for a capture with no supplier filled in yet - mirrors mobile.approve.untitled's wording.
mobile.home.item.draft_expense_untitled.en: An untitled receipt is missing details

mobile.home.item.draft_invoice.nl: Conceptfactuur aan {customer} is nog niet verstuurd
mobile.home.item.draft_invoice.en: Draft invoice to {customer} has not been sent yet

mobile.home.state.overdue_invoice.note: The row's state label under its description (.design/Main.dc.html). The reserved colour is spent on this, never on the action.

mobile.home.action.overdue_invoice.note: The row's one action. Opens the invoice; a reminder e-mail is not built, so the button does not promise one.

mobile.approve.empty_hint.note: FR-UX-004: what belongs here and where it comes from.
mobile.approve.empty_hint.nl: Elke bon die u vastlegt komt hier terecht totdat de gegevens compleet zijn. Leg een bon vast om te beginnen.
mobile.approve.empty_hint.en: Every receipt you capture lands here until its details are complete. Capture a receipt to get started.
